name: AIPullRequestReviewPrompt
friendlyName: AI PR Review with Custom Prompt
description: This task uses OpenAI to generate a pull request review with custom prompt.
author: inskyid

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.label: Api key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key of OpenAI or Azure OpenAI.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.helpMarkDown: The model/deployment to use (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Foundry partner models such as Grok and Kimi). If no model is selected, defaults to GPT 4.1 Mini when using an Azure endpoint; otherwise defaults to GPT 3.5 Turbo when using OpenAI.

inputs.name: max_output_tokens
inputs.label: Max output tokens
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum tokens for the model output. For reasoning models (e.g. GPT-5-mini), this budget covers both reasoning and output — set a higher value (4096+). Used as `max_output_tokens` (Responses API), `max_tokens` (OpenAI-compatible chat), or `max_completion_tokens` (Azure OpenAI chat).

inputs.name: reasoning_effort
inputs.label: Reasoning effort
inputs.helpMarkDown: Controls how much reasoning effort the model spends (only used for reasoning models like GPT-5-mini via the Responses API). Lower effort = fewer reasoning tokens consumed, leaving more budget for actual output text.

inputs.name: aoi_endpoint
inputs.label: Azure OpenApi Endpoint
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure OpenApi Endpoint, leave empty to use default endpoint. (optional)

inputs.name: support_self_signed_certificate
inputs.label: Support self-signed certificate
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select this option to support self-signed certificate.

inputs.name: file_extensions_to_ignore
inputs.label: File Extensions to Ignore
inputs.helpMarkDown: List of file extensions to ignore (e.g., .zip, .mp3, .mp4). Leave empty to process all extensions.

inputs.name: use_commit_messages_as_context
inputs.label: Use PR title & description as context
inputs.helpMarkDown: Include Azure DevOps PR title and description as additional context when generating review comments.

inputs.name: override_prompt
inputs.label: Override prompt
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select this option to override the original prompt.

inputs.name: custom_prompt
inputs.label: Custom prompt
inputs.helpMarkDown: Custom prompt to be added to original prompt. (optional)
